reason: Qahwa BLK is my default and I already know what I get there, but 70 seats with Wi-Fi open until midnight is useful for exam study nights, so I'd try Moro a couple of times when my usual place is full. On Talabat I'd only order if the delivery fee beats what I pay now.
objection: Why switch from a place I already trust? 37 reviews is not many, and with delivery fees on top a 3.50 latte stops being cheap on my salary.
would_change_my_mind: A free or low delivery fee on Talabat/Careem, or a study deal like a refill or discount for staying a few hours, would make it my regular spot.
